title: Super Mario Maker / Super Mario World: Frozen Wiggler
description:
Originally posted by FailSandwich
I wonder if the ice wiggler is here?


Well, now it is! A wiggler frozen in an ice block. Contains both 7-colour (half a palette row) and 15-colour (full palette row) versions. They both use the same map16. Acts like a cement block, and to make it slippery either toggle that setting for the level or use a custom slippery block.

It uses BG2 slot. It combines a Wiggler graphics with Super Mario Maker's Frozen Blocks.
